headline: Approved $129,150.00 for Moshassuck Street soil disposal and a referenda self-mailer contract with $5,586.00 printing and $17,556.00 postage.
summary: Approved a $129,150.00 proposal to dispose of soil from the Moshassuck Street right-of-way, paid from the Sewer Bond. Approved a contract with Graphic Image of Milton, CT, for referenda self-mailers. Approved permission to advertise an RFP for snow plowing and sanding services.
decisions: Approved the August 27, 2026 meeting minutes, unanimously.

Approved permission to advertise an RFP for snow plowing and sanding services, unanimously.
Approved a $129,150.00 proposal from International Paving of West Warwick to dispose of soil on Moshassuck St, paid from the Sewer Bond, unanimously.

# CITY OF PAWTUCKET

## OFFICE OF THE PURCHASING DIVISION

DONALD R. GREBIEN, MAYOR

PETER WINGATE, PURCHASING DIRECTOR

Approved by: [signature]
Date: 9/24/26

## Purchasing Board Meeting Minutes
September 10, 2026

Present: Lisa Bessette, Nancy Pelletier, Christopher Brouillette, Mark Wildenhain, Peter Wingate, Purchasing Director, Jeannine Bourski, Acting Finance Director

Absent:

Public Input Period: (none)

Bid Openings: 27-005 Police & Crossing Guard Uniforms (1 bid)

Minutes: August 27, 2026 meeting minutes have been accepted. Jeannine Bourski makes a motion to approve. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved

### Communications:

Peter Wingate, Purchasing Director, on behalf of the Board of Canvassers, is notifying the Board that an award has been made for RFP # 27-002 - 2026 Board of Canvassers Referenda Self-Mailers, to Graphic Image of Milton, CT, the lone responsive bidder to the RFP. Total contract of $5,586.00 for printing and $17,556.00 for postage is a budgeted Fund 100 item. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Jeannine Bourski seconds. Unanimously approved.

Rick Karsulavitch, DPW, requests permission to advertise an RFP for Snow Plowing and Sanding Services for the upcoming winter, all expenses budgeted yearly in General Fund 100. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved..

Joe Morais, DPW, is notifying the Board that, per RI Department of Environmental mandate to remediate the City's right-of-way on Moshassuck St, the City reached out to its contractor International Paving of West Warwick to provide a proposal on the City's behalf to dispose of the soil. Agreed-to proposal in the amount of $129,150.00 to be paid out of the Sewer Bond. Nancy Pelletier makes a motion to approve. Mark Wildenhain seconds. Unanimously approved

Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to adjourn. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved.

Peter Wingate

[signature]

Purchasing Director
